core_meaning.primary_meaning: Moiz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who honours, giver of honour”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Moiz corresponds to the Arabic form معز (Arabic root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z); مُعِزّ (Muʿizz)). Its core sense is moiz; one who honours. Moiz is Arabic مُعِزّ (Muʿizz) 'one who honours, giver of honour', from the root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z). The source gloss 'Desirable, Precious' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as moeez and moez.
